purpose: Teach: 魔王/アーケード/パイプライン/抗体/動植物/音階/鷲/製鉄

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが魔王の絵を描いてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to draw you a picture of a demon king.
lines.style: Warm, slightly playful lilt. Soft attack. Gentle pace like she's making an offer, not a performance. Voice settles at the end like she's already imagining his face.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママと商店街のアーケードでお買物したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went shopping with Mom at the arcade in the shopping street!
lines.style: Quick bright opening. Eager but not loud — the kind of child who bounces in his seat more than his voice. Almost talking faster than his breath can keep up. Little uptick at the end, inviting her into the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがパイプラインのお仕事してらっしゃるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I heard your dad works with pipelines.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening. Pause before 'pipelines' — she's noticing something about him, not just making conversation. Warm but removed, like she's holding something he hasn't said yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、健康診断で抗体検査受けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I have to get an antibody test at my health checkup.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Slight tension underneath — he's telling her something that matters, not just updating. Small voice on the medical part, like he's being brave about something small.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、動植物の図鑑、メイ姉さんに見せてもらえる?
lines.en: Sho, would you show me your animal and plant encyclopedia?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, not performing interest. Warm request. Slight lean-in to the question. Pace is unhurried — she wants to know what he knows.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアノの音階を練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced my piano scales today!
lines.style: Proud but restrained — his pride is quiet and real, not performed. Slight lift on 'scales,' the part he's proud of. Brief and clean, the way he offers something he's done well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、鷲の写真を撮ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought back a photograph of an eagle.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost dreamy opening. Soft voice like she's sharing something lovely she noticed. Slight warmth on 'eagle' — she's noticing what would matter to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、社会で製鉄の単元やったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, we learned about steel manufacturing in social studies.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Opening with a little weight — he's sharing something he learned and understood. Steady pace. Small voice but grounded, like he's telling her something true.
